integrity: Exact rational and quadratic-field identities have been independently reconstructed by the included standard-library checker. Analytic full-support convexity and Kronecker density are the mathematical proof of existence. No physical measurement or independent expert validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Existence is nonconstructive: the physical times and optimal minimum support count are not determined. No conclusions for other cycles or different Hamiltonians. The published-literature comparison cannot exclude all alternative equivalents.
scientific_scope: Exact adjacency-Hamiltonian continuous-time quantum mixing on the unweighted eight-cycle; arbitrarily late strictly positive-time finite sampling, at most five common atoms.
title: At most five observation times suffice for exact randomized uniform mixing on the eight-cycle
